βλεφάρων: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. gen. pl., after κατά: ’down from the eyelids’

γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle

δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶρα: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom. pl. · also neut. acc. pl., object of διδοῖς: ’gifts’

θέτις: Θέτις — Thetis, sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. nom. sg.
θεάων: θεά — goddess; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θεῶν), partitive: ’of the goddesses’

θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’

θᾶσσον: ταχύς — swift; comparative adv. θᾶσσον (= Attic θᾶττον) ’more swiftly, the sooner’
θῖνα: θίς — shore, beach; fem. acc. sg.

κατακτάμεν: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. inf., epic (= Attic κατακτεῖναι)

κλαίοντα: κλαίω — weep; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’weeping’
κλυτὰ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. acc. pl., with δώματ’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with δώματα: ’famous’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with τεύχεα: ’famous’

κούρης: κούρη — girl, maiden (Attic κόρη); fem. gen. sg.
κρατερῇ: κρατερός — strong, mighty, fierce; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ)
κροκόπεπλος: κροκόπεπλος — saffron-robed (κρόκος ’saffron’ + πέπλος ’robe’), epithet of Dawn; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.

λυγρά: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’grievous things’
λυρνησσὸν: Λυρνησσός — Lyrnessus, a town sacked by Achilles; acc. sg.

νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)

οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα) · also ’that’, introducing what was learned (πεύθετο … οὕνεκ’ … ἔμελλον ’learned that they were about to’)
οὖδας: οὖδας — ground, earth, floor; neut. acc. sg.
οὖτα: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. 3 sg., epic, without augment: ’stabbed’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’all (days)’ (ἤματα πάντα ’all days’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάρα: παρά — beside, at hand; adv. with the accent drawn back (anastrophe) before a form of εἰμί: πάρα … εἰσι = πάρεισι ’are at hand’ · also πάρα = πάρεστι ’is at hand’, with ellipsis of the verb (τῷ … πάρα εἷς γε θεῶν ’beside him is one of the gods’) · also prep. + gen., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’from beside, from’ (γαμβροῖο πάρα ’from his son-in-law’) · also prep. + dat., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’by, beside’ (νηῒ πάρα ’by the ship’) · also prep. + acc., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’beside’ (ποταμὸν πάρα ’beside the river’)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also with a future, ’first, before that’ (πάρος … καθέξει ’first … will hold’)
πέφαται: φένω — slay; perf. pass. 3 sg. πέφαται, epic: ’has been slain’
παρίστατο: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, come up to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.: ’stood by’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πατρόκλῳ: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. dat. sg.
παύω: παύω — stop, make cease; pres. 1 sg. act. (indic.): ’I stop’
πειρήσομαι: πειράω — try, make trial (of); fut. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic πειράσομαι), or hortatory aor. subj.: ’I shall try’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολυθαρσὲς: πολυθαρσής — very daring, full of courage (πολύ + θάρσος); neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with μένος
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτετύχθαι: προτεύχω — make beforehand; perf. inf. pass., with ἐάσομεν + acc.: ’to have been done before, to be done and past’
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of’ (πρόσθεν ἕθεν ’in front of him’)
πρώτῃ: πρῶτος — first; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ὑσμίνῃ: ’in the first (fight)’
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’) · also acc. pl. after ἐς: ’to the feet’ (ἐς πόδας ἄκρους ’to the tips of the feet’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν): ’gave’
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
σέλας: σέλας — light, gleam, flash; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σμερδαλέα: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐσσι: τίς δὲ σύ ἐσσι ’who are you?’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε (elided τ’): ’you’ (σύ τ’ ἐϋφρήνῃς ’that you may gladden’)
σῆς: σός — your, yours (sg.); possessive adj., fem. gen. sg., agreeing with βοῆς
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέσσαι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish; aor. inf. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic τελέσαι): ’to accomplish’
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τόδ’ αἰνὸν ἄχος ’this dread grief’)
τόσσοι: τόσος — so many, so great; masc. nom. pl., epic τόσσος (= Attic τοσοῦτοι)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’until’
τύνη: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., epic emphatic τύνη (= Attic σύ)

τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)

φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., of wish: ’may she carry’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to bring’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might bring’ (ἵν’ … φέροι ’so that she might bring’) · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in an indefinite relative clause (ὅς τις … φέροι): ’whoever might carry’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. with κε, potential in a past unfulfilled condition: ’would have carried off’
φέρουσα: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. act., fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying, bringing’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φωνήσασα: φωνέω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having spoken’
φόως: φῶς (φάος) — light; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φῶς) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’light’; figurative ’deliverance, safety’
φύγῃσι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic φύγῃ), with αἴ κε: ’if he escape’
φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; aor. 3 sg. root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔφυ), intransitive; ἔν … φῦ in tmesis (= ἐνέφυ): ’clung to’
φῦλα: φῦλον — tribe, race; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’tribes’
φῶτας: φώς — man, warrior, mortal; masc. acc. pl.
χαλκήρεϊ: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze (χαλκός + ἀραρίσκω); adj. of two endings, dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
χείρεσσιν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic χερσίν): ’in the hands’
χρόα: χρώς — skin, flesh, complexion; masc. acc. sg. χρόα
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, one must; impersonal verb + acc. and inf.
χρὼς: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; masc. nom. sg.
χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.

ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’) · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition (ἀγλαὰ τέκνα ’splendid children’)
ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ) · also the place where the assembly meets: ’in the assembly-place’ (εἰν ἀγορῇ)
ἀγῶνι: ἀγών — gathering, place of assembly; masc. dat. sg., of place with ἐν

ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’)
ἀλεγεινῆς: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; adj., fem. gen. sg.
ἀλκήν: ἀλκή — defensive strength, might, valour; fem. acc. sg., also of respect: ’in might’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)

ἀμφοτέροισιν: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’ · also dat. of interest: ’for both’
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; fem. dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀνιστάμενος: ἀνίστημι — raise up; mid. ’stand up, rise’; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
ἀντηνορίδης: Ἀντηνορίδης — son of Antenor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.

ἀργυρόπεζα: ἀργυρόπεζα — silver-footed, epithet of Thetis; fem. nom. sg.
ἀρείων: ἀρείων — better, braver; comparative of ἀγαθός (cf. ἄριστος); masc. nom. sg.
ἀσπασίως: ἀσπάσιος — glad, welcome; adv. ἀσπασίως: ’gladly, joyfully’
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.

ἀχιλλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἀχνύμενοί: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.

ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.

ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρειον: ἀρείων — better, stronger; comparative; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τεῖχος: ’stronger’
ἄρεος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρεος (= Attic Ἄρεως)
ἄρτεμις: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis, goddess of the hunt and of sudden painless death (esp. of women); fem. nom. sg.
ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling (ἀ- + root of ’say’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κῦδος: ’boundless’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beyond measure, boundlessly’
ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; fut. 1 pl. act. + acc. and inf.: ’we will allow (him) to’ · also + acc. alone: ’leave be’ (κεῖνον ἐάσομεν ’we shall leave him be’)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., stressed (non-enclitic): ’to me’
ἐμὴ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἲς: ’my’
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐμῆς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. gen. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξεφάνη: ἐκφαίνω — show forth; aor. 3 sg. pass., intransitive: ’appeared, came into view’
ἐπέπαυτ: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); plpf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπέπαυτ’ = ἐπέπαυτο): ’had ceased’
ἐπιεικὲς: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., used impersonally with ἐστί
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἑλόμην: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 1 sg. (stem ἑλ-): ’I took (for myself)’
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔγχεος: ἔγχος — spear; neut. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἔγχους)
ἔδυ: δύω — go in, sink down; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist ἔδυ): ’went down into’
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic, shortened (= Attic εἶναι; cf. ἔμμεναι) · also μένω — stay, wait; impf. 3 sg., elided, augmented (ἔμεν’ = ἔμενε): ’he waited’
ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, masc./fem. nom. sg., predicate
ἔν: ἐν — in, among; prep. + dat., accented ἔν before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε ’and among’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ) · also accented ἔν before the enclitic γε (ἔν γ’ αὐτοσταδίῃ ’in close combat’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
ἔριδι: ἔρις — strife, quarrel; fem. dat. sg.
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
ἔτρεσαν: τρέω — tremble, flee in fear; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’trembled’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’) · also pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter subject: ’holding’ · also ’had, sustained’ (πόνον ἔχον ’sustained toil’)
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’)
ἕλκος: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕλον: αἱρέω — take; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλον); ἐκ … ἕλον in tmesis ’picked out’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I took away’ · also in battle: ’killed’ (ἕλον ἄνδρα ’killed a man’)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also ἠώς — morning, dawn (the time of day, not the goddess); fem. nom. sg.: ’it was morning’ (ἠὼς ἦν)
ἡμετέροιο: ἡμέτερος — our; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; by metonymy, fire; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥρωας: ἥρως — hero, man of rank or noble birth; acc. pl.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἰάχων: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’crying out’
ἰότητι: ἰότης — will, wish, favour; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the will of’
ἰῷ: ἰός — arrow; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an arrow’ (not ἰός ’poison’) · also ἰῷ = Attic μιᾷ, ’one’, dat. sg. agreeing with ἤματι (ἰῷ … ἤματι ’on a single day’)
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’ · also οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 pl., epic ἴσαν (= Attic ᾔδεσαν): ’knew’
ἵζοντο: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they sat down’
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth, biting; adv.
ὀλέσσας: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλέσας): ’having destroyed’
ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄρνυθ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; mid. rise, arise; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (ὄρνυθ’ = ὄρνυτο; Attic ὤρνυτο): ’was rising’
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνον): ’urged on’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’urge on!’
ὄφελ: ὀφέλλω (= ὀφείλω) — owe; ought; ὄφελ’ = ὄφελε(ν), aor. 3 sg. unaugmented, + inf. in an unfulfilled wish: ’would that … had’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … ὤσαιτο ’so that he might drive back’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅπλα: ὅπλον — tool, implement; pl. arms, armour, gear; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’)
ὑσμίνῃ: ὑσμίνη — battle, fray; fem. dat. sg.
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοισι: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl. · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for whom’ · also ἵημι — send, hurl, throw; aor. subj. 3 sg., contracted, epic -σι (ᾗσι = ἕῃσι): ’throws’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥοάων: ῥοή — stream, flow; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
